scope: Read-only official web-driver JavaScript and a whitelisted summary of the local vendor-origin device-settings cache. No browser account records, macros, passwords, or vendor USB requests are included.

generic_shared_protocol_features.nkroSwitch: Read/written as byte 17 of generic game-mode data; supported values and meaning on this NUT75 are NOT established.
generic_shared_protocol_features.visibility_filter: Functions are filtered by model fnFuncIds union device-derived defaultFnFuncIds. Shared strings are NOT proof of NUT75 support.

cached_settings_NOT_live_hardware_state.nkroSwitch_0_semantics: Unknown; do not assume this means a working BIOS/6KRO mode.
cached_settings_NOT_live_hardware_state.method: Whitelist-only fields from vendor-origin IndexedDB WAL. V8 signed-varint values independently decoded. A private clone was additionally decoded with local serialization-header adaptation; no complete settings/profile record retained here.
